question: Which Russian city hosted the 2024 BRICS Summit in October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kazan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The** 2024 BRICS Summit** was hosted in **Kazan, Russia**, from October 22-24, 2024.
 
• Kazan is the capital city of the Republic of Tatarstan, Russia, and is known for its rich cultural heritage and history.
 
• The summit focused on key issues like **economic cooperation**, **global governance reform**, sustainable development, and technological collaboration among BRICS nations.
 
• BRICS comprises five major economies: Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa, collectively representing approximately 42% of the world’s population and 27% of global GDP.
 
• This summit marked the continuation of discussions on expanding the BRICS group and enhancing intra-member trade in local currencies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BRICS Overview:**

 
 
• BRICS was established in 2009 as a platform for economic and political cooperation among emerging economies.
 
• Its members aim to reform global financial institutions like the IMF and World Bank to better reflect the interests of developing nations.
 
 
 
• **Kazan’s Significance:**
 
 
• Kazan is a prominent city in Russia, known for its unique blend of **Eastern and Western cultures**.
 
• It is a UNESCO-recognized city for its historical landmarks, including the Kazan Kremlin, a World Heritage site.
 
 
 
• **Key Outcomes of the 2024 BRICS Summit:**
 
 
• Discussions on the establishment of a new development bank to enhance financial collaboration among BRICS nations.
 
• Agreements to promote the use of **national currencies** for trade within BRICS countries, reducing reliance on the US dollar.
 
• Commitments toward advancing **green energy projects** and combating climate change.
 
 
 
• **Future of BRICS:**
 
 
• Continued efforts to include more member countries, enhancing the group’s global influence.
 
• Focus on achieving equitable growth and sustainable development across member nations.
